scope: Current Viem normative command matrix, adopted options and GAPS feature-family dispositions; not an exhaustive Vim index.

entries.decision: The normative command fixtures are executable matrices; counts/registers/operators/repeat/undo have separate exact-result tests.
Normal-mode U is retired. Ordinary u/Ctrl-R history remains; Visual U and gU still uppercase text. There is no separate saved-line undo state.

Named/uppercase-append registers, counted/nested playback, event identity, recursion/work limits, semantic dot and :normal! are implemented. Expression/runtime and cross-file replay facilities are not adopted.

Viem Regex v2 adds \< and \> directional edges using the same Unicode Alphabetic/Mark/Nd/Pc/Join_Control word class as \w and \b, independent of Vim iskeyword and Viem keyword extraction. Prior pattern/replacement semantics and */# generated \b...\b patterns remain unchanged. Compiled/cache identities include the dialect version; unsupported Vim atoms remain rejected.
Versioned config.json is the native application preferences authority, with atomic writes, validation, legacy migration and unknown-key retention.
Four format-specific sparse default files cascade below source declarations and never serialize inherited fields as direct formatting.
:e active-pane replacement, case-sensitive :E new window, :pwd/:cd/:checktime/:update, alternate/ranged writes and Save As use native document lifecycle. Hidden buffer/argument lists are not adopted.
Native recovery journal/ownership, immutable source saves, readonly guards, external-change warnings and stale overwrite protection are provided. Vim swap/backup/autoread options are not emulated.
Mouse/Shift selection, native clipboard commands, selectable read-only output with X and keyboard context menu.
AppKit preference-adjusted wheel deltas are consumed once.
Explicit HTML/Markdown semantic conversion, loss warnings, explicit Latin1 replacement policy and native monospace Code/Code Block styles.

Stored/special clipboard/current-file/last-insert registers, local marks, typed jumps, branch-aware undo/time navigation. Session/global-file/expression registers and cross-file change lists are not adopted.
Visual-row navigation, desired x, shaped graphemes and row-tagged block extents replace terminal screen cells.
Paragraph/character styles, geometric indentation, lists and soft wrapping replace fixed-column formatting options.
Only actual Viem settings are accepted; no inert aliases, synthetic option types or a second Vim configuration authority.

The profile startup.viem initializes supported settings and mode-scoped recursive/nonrecursive mappings. Interactive mapping changes are buffer-scoped. Multi-key prefixes, function-key notation, counts, registers, undo and bounded expansion use the portable command pipeline; general Vimscript and mapping expressions remain unsupported.
User abbreviations, expression input, scripting, custom commands/operators and plugins remain outside the explicitly bounded command model.
Native documents/windows and stacked views own file lifecycle; hidden Vim buffers, argument traversal and tab-local directory state introduce a parallel model.

Command pipelines/modifiers, global/vglobal, retab, execute, user commands and file iteration require a separate batch/provenance policy and are not implicitly adopted by an agent-generated parity list.

Buffer-shared hlsearch/hls and incsearch/is default off and support startup.viem. :nohlsearch/:noh temporarily suppresses accepted-pattern highlighting. Read-only counted /? and addressed substitute match previews support Ctrl-G/Ctrl-T, Enter and Escape. The internal, customizable Incremental match style overlays explicit declarations after the existing cascade and is excluded from assignment menus/APIs. Snapshot-bound cooperative viewport highlighting retains bounded matches; display-only cluster expansion preserves logical ranges and source/history state.
Vim regex modes, offsets, expression/case-conversion replacements and history files are outside canonical Regex v2.
Fixed-column hard reflow, virtual terminal padding, Virtual Replace, code indentation and delimiter/tag-source motions do not define the formatted prose model.
Core Visual modes plus native selection/IME provide the adopted selection model; no parallel Vim Select mode.
Language tooling, syntax engines, tags/LSP/build/quickfix, shells/filters/jobs/channels and terminal buffers are outside this prose editor.
Remote Ex, server/client scripting and interprocess automation are not exposed; native open-file routing and recovery ownership remain the supported mechanisms.
Terminal number/whitespace gutters, gVim toolbar and broad display-option emulation are not added solely for parity; native typography/status and current accessibility stay authoritative.

:sort supports hard-line ranges, reverse, case-insensitive/unique, integer numeric bases, and Regex v2 keys as one verified source permutation. Plain/source rows, Markdown prose paragraphs and balanced sibling HTML paragraphs preserve source spelling and styles. Floating/locale sorting and ambiguous rich/RTF row ownership are unsupported.
